# fast-static-site

> Incremental static site generator with a hand-written CommonMark subset, strict templates and a dependency graph that rebuilds only the pages a change touches Rust crate `trysac-fast-static-site`, library `fast_static_site`, MIT licensed,
> Rust >= 1.88 (edition 2024), standard library only.

- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): shape of the crate and its public API
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend the tests
